source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Ιανουαρίου — «Όσιος Ζωσιμάς»

attestations.note: His page opens by distinguishing him from the Abba Zosimas who found Mary of Egypt and is kept on 4 April: «άλλος από τον Αββά Ζωσιμά». It gives him no country, no monastery and no year, so the day is what tells him apart.
